title: grid group header: a min / max aggregation over a datetime field renders NaN
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Blocks cloud#4278 (p2, SCIM provisioning console); drafted by the cloud#4278 card thread (session_01JQwxbY3zqaaaSj7tJsov3a) and filed by the seat.

Edition / version: ObjectOS Enterprise, cloud main, framework pin 99992ddf. Consumer: cloud SCIM provisioning console (`packages/security-enterprise/src/scim/scim-provisioning-console.ts`, grid "Last sync per connection", `aggregations: [{ field: 'created_at', type: 'max' }]`), reported on cloud#4278 item 1 (`92 · max: NaN`).

Why (code): `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useGroupedData.ts` `readServerAggregations` casts every summary with `Number(value)` (and the client path `computeAggregations` maps rows through `Number(r[field])`), `AggregationResult.value` is typed `number | null`, and `GroupRow.tsx` prints `agg.value.toFixed(2)`. An ISO datetime string becomes `NaN`. The header query itself answers the right value (the spec's `deriveColumnSummary`).

Seam: `spec:ListView.aggregations[].type ('min'|'max')` → `renderer:plugin-grid GroupRow / readServerAggregations`.

Expected: a `min`/`max` over a date or datetime field shows the time, formatted the way the field's cell is (locale, timezone); `sum`/`avg` over a non-numeric field is refused at parse or left out, never printed as `NaN`. Test: a grouped grid over a datetime `max` renders the formatted time.

Dedupe words: "group header NaN", "aggregation max datetime", "GroupRow toFixed", "grouping aggregations date".
